Existing open-source tools are great for standard experiments. They are not particularly modular or interoperable.

## Advancing multiphoton imaging {.smaller}

::: {.incremental}

* multi-day recordings
* imaging at higher frequencies
* deeper in the brain
* larger fields of view
* volumetric imaging
* in freely moving animals

:::

#

To deal with this complexity, we need to coordinate analysis software at a community level.

::: {.incremental style="font-size: 0.6em;"}
* BrainGlobe (software for neuroanatomy): ~150 contributors
* `movement` (software for behavioural video analysis): ~70 contributors
* `spikeinterface` (softwaer for electrophysiology analysis): two core developers based at SWC
:::

::: {.notes}

All of this has some problems. The tools are not interoperable with each other: if you use the registration algorithm from one, you are locked-into the segmentation step of the same tool. Work is duplicated, and the support for these tools could be better.

So to adapt to our changing needs, we need to improve on this. Areas that could do with improvement are flexibility, guidance, performance, transparency, collaboration. And we can't do this alone, we need feedback. So we see this more as a social problem rather than a technical problem.

As NIU we have a successful track record of building software for research at a community level.
:::

## `photon-mosaic`: Vision

![](img/framework_schematic.png)

::: {.incremental}
* Python library: one function per step
* Pipeline: configure and run on HPC with one command
:::


## Flexibility

:::: {.columns style="display: flex; gap: 1em; align-items: center;"}
::: {.column style="width: 50%;"}
![](img/external_figures/suite2p_sample_registered.mp4){width="100%" autoplay="false" loop="false" muted="true"}
:::

::: {.column style="width: 50%;"}
```{.python code-line-numbers="3"}
motion = compute_motion(
    imaging=imaging, 
    method="suite2p")
registered_imaging = register_motion(
    imaging=imaging, 
    motion=motion)
```
motion correction
:::
::::

segmentation

## Simplicity {.smaller}

```python
photon-mosaic-pipeline --config config.yaml
```

* Edit the default configuration file
* Run on many files with a single command

## Performance {.smaller}

```python
photon-mosaic-pipeline --config config.yaml --jobs 5
```

* Distribute across HPC jobs
* Re-runs only required parts of pipeline
